fusions.name: Picked to the Bone
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 30% health, dealing 22 damage, leaving it 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and healing you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Nesting Bites
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health to loose 3 rats from your plate, spread apart, each dealing 7 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarm in the Seams
fusions.desc: Releases a swarm from your plate for 12 seconds that bites enemies within 3 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Outlast the Wreck
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 60 seconds.
